result.summary: Frozen trunk plus source logits and legal mask produced positive robust and worst-continuation lower bounds for k=4,8,16,32 on independent 512-state data; raw observation features were poor. The k16 selector changed 18 rows whose mean source-logit gap was 9.8916, and all 18 exceeded the prior two-sided 4.2 residual cap.
result.conclusion: Do not deploy the kNN selector as an action gate or claim it as a trained policy.
